description: Beeldbepalend erfgoed - Monumentale bebouwing langs historische vaarwegen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Deze kaartlaag toont monumentale bebouwing langs historische vaarwegen. Monumenten, oriëntatiepunten en identiteitsdragers, zoals benoemd in de gebiedsprofielen van de provincie Zuid-Holland, die zich binnen een zone van 500 meter langs (historische) vaarwegen bevinden, worden in de context geplaatst van het door de tijd heen sterk veranderende waternetwerk. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are cultuur, cultuurbehoud, cultuurbeleid, cultuurhistorie. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, PNG, WFS_SRVC, WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
